name: Home: Notes row
what: Home lists Notes under Gallery: 'Write privately, with your model's help.'

name: Notes list
what: Tap Notes on Home: one glass list on the living field, rows animate in, each with title, what it says and when.

name: Search notes
what: Search reads titles and text; no match says so in one line, and the field clears with one tap.

name: New note
what: New answers at once and opens an empty note, focused, with the format bar over the keyboard.

name: Writing a note
what: Typing into the note; the first line becomes its title in the list.

name: Back to the list
what: Back from a note: the list shows the edit at the top.

versions.label: Spinner stuck
versions.what: Before: a refresh spinner turned above the list for good after coming back from a note (iOS).

versions.label: Spinner only on pull
versions.what: After: the list updates silently on return; the spinner shows only for a pull.

name: Scribe underlines in chat
what: Typing in the chat composer: Scribe underlines spelling and grammar, on the phone, no network.

versions.label: Spelling silent
versions.what: Before: only rule checks (lowercase i); misspellings were not flagged in the dev app, the dictionary never loaded.

versions.label: Spelling flagged
versions.what: After: recieved, mesage, definately, tomorow are underlined.

name: Fix bar
what: Caret on a flagged word: up to three fixes, Add to dictionary, Ignore.

name: A fix applied
what: Tap a fix: the word changes and the bar goes, since the caret is now on clean text.

name: Select All: iOS menu over Improve
what: After Select All, iOS puts its edit menu over the Improve bar. A tap in the selection hides it.

name: Improve on a selection
what: With text selected, the bar offers Improve.

name: Improve
what: Improve: the quick fix first ('5 fixed'), then the model's version streams in. Change and Tone chips, Another version, a quicker-model hint.

versions.label: Think tags leaked
versions.what: Before: K2 Horizon's empty <ifm|think></ifm|think> streamed into the version until it finished.

versions.label: Clean stream
versions.what: After: the version streams with no tags.

name: Replace
what: Replace puts the picked version in the composer; nothing stale stays selected.

versions.label: Stale selection
versions.what: Before: after a Replace, Improve opened on 'tomorro', the old range on the new text.

versions.label: Caret after the version
versions.what: After: the caret sits after the version; Improve is offered only for a new selection.
